problem:
If $X$ is a $5\times 7$ matrix and $Y$ is a $10\times 5$ matrix, then the dimensions of $YX$ are{{field-1}}$\times $
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
There are $5$ columns in $Y$ and $5$ rows in $X.$ Since the number of columns in $Y$ equals the number of rows in $X,$ the matrices $Y$ and $X$ are conformable for multiplication, and $YX$ is a $10\times 7$ matrix:

$$
{Y}_{10\times \boxed{\text{5}}}{\times }_{✓}{X}_{\boxed{\text{5}}\times 7}={YX}_{10\times 7}
$$
